_doc: E-E-A-T signal catalog (belge 03 s.5). assessor: llm | det | det+llm | na. 'claim' signals measure what the page CLAIMS, not whether it is true. Weights are this product's internal model, not Google's.

signals.definition: The author describes first-hand experience with the topic (first-person narrative: 'I tested', 'we built', concrete process they went through).
The text states or captions original material (own photos, screenshots, data, measurements). Images themselves are not visible; judge only the text.
A concrete case study or real example with specific details (names, numbers, dates, outcomes).
The process or methodology used is described step by step.
Before/after results or outcome data are given.
A specific anecdote that would be hard to invent. A quote already used for E1 must not be reused here.
Author credentials relevant to the topic are stated (bio, role, certification, years of practice).
Claims, statistics or figures are supported by a named source or evidence.
The page shows a publication/modification date that is recent (within 24 months).
An author name/byline is visible.
The page CLAIMS awards, certifications or accreditations.
The page CLAIMS media coverage or publication in recognised outlets ('as featured in').
The page CLAIMS professional memberships or affiliations.
Clear contact information (address, phone, e-mail, or a contact page link).
A privacy policy and/or terms of use link exists (any language; e.g. 'Gizlilik Politikasi', 'KVKK', 'Terms').
The page is served over HTTPS with a valid certificate.
It is transparent who creates the content and why (an 'About' link, byline, or an explanation of the organisation).
Customer reviews or testimonials are present (their existence, not their truth).
A visible update history or 'last updated' note, or a corrections policy.
A return/refund policy link is visible (e-commerce pages only).

not_assessed.reason: factual accuracy cannot be verified from the page
correct use of specialist vocabulary cannot be verified from the page
publication history needs more than one page
deceptive practices need judgement; not measured
payment security cannot be verified from the page
